quote: “Nothing can ever happen twice. In consequence, the sorry fact is that we arrive here improvised and leave without the chance to practice.”
source: Wisława Szymborska, Nothing Twice, lines 1 to 4, Calling Out to Yeti (1957) (trans. Stanisław Barańczak and Clare Cavanagh, 1995)

evidence.where: Poetry Chaikhana reprint of the Barańczak and Cavanagh translation, checked line by line; Harcourt Brace 1995 catalogue entries for View with a Grain of Sand, which covers 1957 to 1993 and includes Nothing Twice from Calling Out to Yeti
evidence.edition: View with a Grain of Sand: Selected Poems, trans. Stanisław Barańczak and Clare Cavanagh (Harcourt Brace, 1995)

reason: The four opening lines match the Barańczak and Cavanagh wording word for word, with only line breaks dropped. Not shipped, not at cap, not banned.
